programs.title_tr: Pratt & Whitney GTF (PW1100G) Toz Metal Kusuru & Yere İndirmeler
programs.title_en: Pratt & Whitney GTF (PW1100G) Powder Metal Defect & Groundings
programs.current_status_tr: Yüksek basınçlı türbin disklerindeki mikroskobik toz metal kirliliği nedeniyle küresel çapta yüzlerce A320neo/A321neo uçağı planlanmamış motor bakımına alındı. Ortalama motor revizyon süresi (TAT) 250-300 günü buluyor.
programs.current_status_en: Contaminated powder metal in high-pressure turbine disks required accelerated inspections; hundreds of A320neo family jets grounded globally with MRO shop turnaround times reaching 250-300 days.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: THY filosundaki yaklaşık 30-40 adet A320/A321neo uçağı yerde bekliyor; kapasite açığını kapatmak için ıslak kiralama (wet lease) ve mevcut A320ceo uçaklarının hizmet ömrünü uzatma yoluna gidildi. Pegasus filosu ağırlıklı CFM LEAP motorlu olduğu için doğrudan etkilenmedi.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Turkish Airlines has 30-40 A321neo aircraft parked; capacity shortfall managed via wet leases and extending older A320ceo service lives. Pegasus remains largely unaffected due to CFM LEAP engine selection.
programs.timeline_horizon: 2026 yılı boyunca ve 2027 ilk yarısına kadar sürmesi bekleniyor.
programs.source_reference: RTX Corporation / FAA Airworthiness Directives (AD 2024-0044) / THY KAP Açıklamaları

programs.title_tr: Boeing 737 MAX Üretim Kısıtı (FAA Aylık 38 Tavanı) & Tedarik Zinciri
programs.title_en: Boeing 737 MAX FAA Monthly 38 Cap & Supply Chain Bottlecks
programs.current_status_tr: FAA'in kalite ve montaj denetimleri kapsamında Boeing 737 üretimini aylık 38 uçak tavanında tutması ve Spirit AeroSystems gövde teslimat gecikmeleri nedeniyle 2026 teslimat takvimleri 3-6 ay geriye ötelendi. MAX 7 ve MAX 10 sertifikasyonu gecikmeye devam ediyor.
programs.current_status_en: FAA capped 737 production at 38/month pending quality audit milestones; Spirit AeroSystems fuselage supply constraints pushed airline delivery slots back by 3 to 6 months. MAX 7 and MAX 10 certification remains pending.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: SunExpress ve THY teslimatları planlanan takvimin gerisinde seyrediyor; havayolları yoğun yaz ve sonbahar kapasite planlamalarını mevcut gövdelerle optimize ediyor.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: SunExpress and Turkish Airlines delivery streams experiencing slot postponements; carriers optimizing utilization on existing fleet assets.
programs.timeline_horizon: Aylık 38 üretim tavanının 2026 sonuna kadar aşamalı olarak artırılması hedefleniyor.
programs.source_reference: FAA Oversight Directives / Boeing Quarterly Deliveries / Airline Fleet Filings

programs.title_tr: Airbus A321XLR Ticari Teslimatları & Dar Gövde Uzun Menzil Devrimi
programs.title_en: Airbus A321XLR Entry into Service & Long-Range Narrowbody Wave
programs.current_status_tr: EASA tip sertifikasyonunu tamamlayan A321XLR, Iberia tarafından Madrid-Boston hattında ilk ticari uçuşlarına başladı. 4.700 deniz mili (8.700 km) menziliyle dar gövdede transatlantik ve kıtalararası uçuş maliyetlerini %30 düşürüyor.
programs.current_status_en: Having achieved EASA certification, the A321XLR commenced transatlantic operations with launch customer Iberia. Its 4,700 nm range unlocks thin long-haul routes at 30% lower trip cost.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: Orta Doğu, Afrika ve ikincil Avrupa şehirlerine doğrudan bağlantı potansiyeli nedeniyle bölge taşıyıcıları tarafından yakından izleniyor. THY ve Pegasus filo stratejilerinde uzun vadeli alternatif.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Closely monitored by regional carriers for secondary point-to-point routes into Africa, Central Asia and Europe; potential long-term fit for Istanbul network.
programs.source_reference: EASA Type Certificate Data Sheet (TCDS) / Airbus Commercial Aircraft Updates

programs.title_tr: Boeing 777-9 (777X) Test Uçuşları & Hizmete Giriş Tarihi
programs.current_status_tr: İtiş kolu bağlantı elemanındaki (thrust link) teknik arıza sonrası test uçuşları geçici olarak durdurulmuştu; Boeing ilk teslimat takvimini 2026 yılına (ve potansiyel olarak 2027'ye) revize etti. Başta Emirates ve Lufthansa olmak üzere amiral gemisi filoları A380 ve 777-300ER ömür uzatmak zorunda kaldı.
programs.current_status_en: Structural component inspection on engine thrust links required test fleet pause; initial deliveries rescheduled to 2026/2027. Major customers Emirates and Lufthansa forced to extend legacy 777-300ER and A380 service lives.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: THY'nin geniş gövde siparişlerinde Airbus A350-1000'e ağırlık vermesinde 777X gecikmeleri belirleyici stratejik etken oldu.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Delays were a primary catalyst for Turkish Airlines' decision to anchor its high-capacity widebody order book on the Airbus A350-1000.
programs.timeline_horizon: FAA tip sertifikasyonu ve ilk ticari teslimat 2026 sonu / 2027 hedefleniyor.
programs.source_reference: Boeing Defense, Space & Security / Airline IR Filings / Emirates President Statements

programs.title_tr: CFM LEAP-1A / 1B Yüksek Basınç Türbini Dayanıklılığı & MRO Bekleme Süreleri
programs.title_en: CFM LEAP-1A / 1B Hot-Section Durability & Shop Visit Backlogs
programs.current_status_tr: Sıcak iklim, tozlu hava sahası ve yüksek iniş-kalkış döngüsü altında çalışan LEAP motorlarında türbin kanatçığı erozyonu nedeniyle planlanandan erken motor indirme yaşanıyor. Küresel MRO atölyelerinde yedek parça ve motor kıtlığı devam ediyor.
programs.current_status_en: Harsh environment operations (heat, sand, high cycle utilization) causing premature hot-section turbine blade wear; global MRO shops experiencing parts constraints and extended turn-around times.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_tr: Pegasus'un filosunun belkemiğini oluşturan A321neo uçaklarında CFM LEAP-1A motorları kullanılıyor. Pegasus, proaktif motor rotasyonu ve yedek motor rezervasyonu ile uçak yerde kalma süresini (AOG) asgaride tutuyor.
programs.thy_pegasus_impact_en: Pegasus relies heavily on CFM LEAP-1A on its A321neo fleet; carrier leverages proactive engine rotation and buffer lease pools to keep AOG rates minimal.
programs.timeline_horizon: CFM'in güncellenmiş dayanıklı parça (durability kit) teslimatları 2026 boyunca yaygınlaşıyor.
programs.source_reference: Safran / GE Aerospace Engine Technical Briefings / Aviation Week MRO Watch

stories.headline: United Airlines Focuses on Premium Experience and Loyalty to Drive Retention
stories.lead: An 18-page report by IdeaWorksCompany highlights United Airlines' strategy centered on premium customer proposition, loyalty programs, co-branded credit cards, and ancillary revenue. Authored by Jay Sorensen, the report examines initiatives introduced throughout 2025 and 2026.
stories.source_description: United Airlines is rapidly reshaping its customer proposition around premium experiences, loyalty, co-branded cards and ancillary revenue, according to a new 18-page IdeaWorksCompany report, “United is Winning the Race for Brand-Loyal Consumers.” Written by airline revenue and loyalty expert Jay Sorensen, the report examines United’s expanding portfolio of products and strategies introduced during 2025 and 2026. United’s lounge network, with 50+ locations, is another critical component of its brand-loyal strategy. The report estimates its network serves about 70,000 daily guests. That’s more than 25 million guests per year, which is equal to the annual passenger traffic of JetBlue. The report also examines United’s “Base” fares for the Premium Plus and Polaris cabins, which removes certain benefits, such as Polaris lounge access and advance seat assignments, for a lower fare.

stories.lead: Emirates has secured the top position in the first-ever World’s Best Airlines 2027 rankings by TIME and Statista, highlighting excellence in customer service and operations.
stories.source_description: DUBAI, UAE, 19 November 2026 : Emirates has been ranked the World’s Best Airline in TIME and Statista’s inaugural World’s Best Airlines 2027 list, which recognises airlines around the world that excel in customer service and operational performance. The airline also took first place in the Best Value and Business Travel categories, alongside high recognition in several other categories. Sir Tim Clark, President, Emirates Airline, said: “Undeterred by the challenges of this year, we continue to invest in product and service across almost every touchpoint. We will maintain that focus because, as this top ranking in TIME shows, customers notice when an airline gets the fundamentals right. A big credit goes to our people who bring the Emirates experience to life in the air and on the ground. Their professionalism and commitment are what our customers experience every day. In our business, there’s no finish line, and we’re already working towards an even stronger 2027 and beyond, so you can expect more from Emirates.” According to TIME, Emirates’ rankings reflect its reputation for some of the industry’s most luxurious flying, its expanding Premium Economy offering and Dubai’s enduring appeal as a destination. Partnerships with tourism organisations across the Indian Ocean, Europe, Southeast Asia and the UAE also help attract more visitors across its network. Niels Terfehr, Deputy CEO Statista R, said: "Emirates' results this year stand out for their consistency. Topping the overall World's Best Airlines ranking, while also leading the Best Value and Business Travel categories, reflects strong performance across both passenger experience and operational reliability - the two pillars our ranking is built on. It's a result grounded entirely in direct feedback from travellers around the world, combined with independent flight-performance data.” The ranking is based on a quantitative study run by Statista, a leading data and business intelligence provider, which surveyed passengers on every continent. Respondents rated their satisfaction with up to five airlines they had flown with in the past three years. They scored cabin comfort, service quality, entertainment and connectivity, food and beverage, value for money and family-friendliness. Statista then combined these ratings with each airline’s operational performance data to produce an overall score. Emirates’ long-standing product and service investments ensure that every journey, in every cabin, delivers a memorable travel experience. Recent highlights from the airline include: A US$ 7 billion cabin retrofit programme moving at pace: To date, 108 Emirates aircraft have been retrofitted, giving customers a more consistent experience across the fleet and bringing the airline’s latest products to more travellers, including the highly acclaimed Premium Economy. By December 2026, Emirates Premium Economy will serve close to 100 destinations across its network. Industry-first comfort innovations: Emirates’ latest market-leading innovations include the world’s first electrically powered Premium Economy seat with a privacy divider, and the U-Dream headrest, a first of its kind in Economy Class. Over the next six months, the electrically powered Premium Economy Class seat with the privacy divider will be available on 11 Emirates aircraft and the new Economy Class Seat U-Dream headrest will be available on 29 Emirates aircraft. Ultra-fast connectivity: Starlink Wi-Fi, now on 74 Emirates aircraft, is complimentary for customers in all cabins to stream content, game, make calls, work, and browse social media throughout their journey on both seatback screens and personal devices simultaneously. Award-winning entertainment: ice , Emirates’ onboard on-demand entertainment system, offers over 6,500 channels of the latest movies, TV shows, music, games and podcasts, on demand and in over 40 languages. Elevated dining onboard: From regional specialities to global favourites, Emirates’ destination-inspired menus reflect the flavours of the places it flies to. At any given time, the airline offers over 1,570 daily menus across its network. Onboard menus change monthly, and recipes are continually reviewed and refined. In the last year, the airline has also introduced a new champagne and wine line-up across every cabin, alongside special and seasonal menus celebrating holidays, special observances as well as its sponsored sporting events. A family-first experience: On almost all routes and in every class, children are served tasty and nutritious kid’s meals. Families traveling with babies are offered organic baby food, milk formula, baby bottles are available on request and infant amenity kits are also provided. On ice , kids can choose from hundreds of entertainment options including Disney, Marvel Studios, Star Wars collections, or indulge in Harry Potter series, in addition to special kids cartoon channels and over 100 video games. Children of every age also get complimentary toys and giveaways, and Cabin crew can take an instant Polaroid set in a limited-edition photo frame as a keepsake. The airline has also run Travel Rehearsals supporting families of children with autism in more than 80 destinations. Built for business: Emirates continues to raise the standard for business travel, with the roll-out of refreshed Business Class cabins and the latest seats across its Boeing 777, Airbus A380 and A350 fleets. On the ground, customers can relax, work or dine in 42 lounges worldwide, including flagship lounges in Dubai, while complimentary chauffeur-drive in eligible markets makes every journey seamless from door to door. stories.headline: Emirates SkyCargo and Virgin Atlantic Cargo Sign MoU for Expanded Cooperation
stories.lead: Emirates SkyCargo and Virgin Atlantic Cargo signed a Memorandum of Understanding on 17 November 2026 to enhance global network connectivity and interline cargo services.
stories.source_description: Shared commitment to operational excellence, with an ambition to set a new standard for interline cargo. Greater connectivity across complementary global networks, creating more choice and opportunities for customers. First active pharma interline agreement between the carriers, opening new possibilities for highly sensitive healthcare shipments. Simpler, more seamless interline booking, building on over a decade of collaboration and 2,000 tonnes of cargo transported in H1 2026. Dubai/ London, 17 November 2026 - Building on more than a decade of successful collaboration, Emirates SkyCargo and Virgin Atlantic Cargo have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to take their partnership further, delivering excellence and expanding possibilities for customers worldwide. Bringing together complementary global networks, aligned operational standards and specialist expertise, the MoU aims to set a new benchmark for interline cargo. Beyond expanding connectivity, the carriers share an ambition to create a seamless, reliable experience that makes interlining a preferred choice for customers, rather than simply an alternative to direct services. The agreement was signed at Emirates Group Headquarters in Dubai by Badr Abbas, Divisional Senior Vice President, Emirates SkyCargo , and Nick Diesel, Managing Director, Virgin Atlantic Cargo. Under the MoU, Emirates SkyCargo and Virgin Atlantic Cargo will explore opportunities to expand cargo interline arrangements and Block Space Agreements (BSAs), strengthening eastbound and westbound connectivity and facilitating global trade. Together, their networks span 158 destinations, creating further opportunities for Emirates SkyCargo across the Americas and Virgin Atlantic Cargo across the Middle East and Asia. The MoU will also enable Emirates SkyCargo and Virgin Atlantic Cargo to interline highly sensitive active pharmaceutical shipments for the first time. Active pharma shipments require the highest levels of protection and zero disruption while in transit, to ensure sensitive products – such as vaccines and insulin – maintain their efficacy. By combining their industry-leading expertise in life sciences and healthcare logistics with the strength of their existing partnership, Emirates SkyCargo and Virgin Atlantic Cargo will be able to transport even the most sensitive shipments with no compromise on quality, care or reliability. The UK provides a natural connection point between the two carriers’ networks, linking the US, Asia and the Middle East through an unbroken cold chain and supporting the fast, reliable movement of critical healthcare products. Emirates SkyCargo and Virgin Atlantic Cargo will also collaborate on ways to make interline booking simpler and more seamless. stories.headline: Emirates Skywards and ENOC Partner to Expand Loyalty Earning Opportunities
stories.lead: Emirates Skywards has partnered with ENOC Group to allow members to earn miles on everyday spending across service stations and retail outlets in the UAE.
stories.source_description: Dubai, UAE, 19 November 2026: Emirates Skywards, the award-winning loyalty programme of Emirates and flydubai, has partnered with ENOC Group, a leading integrated global energy player, to make everyday spending even more rewarding for members across the UAE. From fuelling cars to vehicle servicing, car washes and picking up daily essentials, members can now earn Skywards Miles on eligible purchases across ENOC's extensive network of service stations , ZOOM convenience stores, AutoPro automotive service centres and ProWash facilities, through the Skywards Everyday app. The agreement was signed by Ali Khalid Bin Zayed Al Falasi, Deputy Chief Commercial & Retail Officer at ENOC Group and Dr Nejib Ben Khedher, Divisional Senior Vice President Emirates Skywards in the presence of His Highness Sheikh Ahmed bin Saeed Al Maktoum, Chairman and Chief Executive, Emirates Airline & Group and His Excellency Saeed Mohammed Al Tayer, Chairman of Emirates National Oil Company (ENOC) Group, alongside senior leaders from both organisations. The strategic partnership brings together two of Dubai's leading brands, unlocking more opportunities for members to earn rewards beyond travel and transforming routine purchases into Miles that can be used towards flights, upgrades and a range of exclusive experiences. The partnership extends across ENOC's wide-ranging retail and automotive network, including more than 215 ZOOM stores, 54 AutoPro sites and 49 ProWash locations, offering members convenient ways to collect Miles as part of their daily routines. Members can also benefit from eligible mobile fuel services within residential communities, bringing even more convenience and rewarding opportunities closer to home. Ali Khalid Bin Zayed Al Falasi, Deputy Chief Commercial & Retail Officer at ENOC Group said: "Enhancing the customer experience and delivering greater value at every touchpoint remain central to our priorities at ENOC. We see strategic partnerships as an important way to achieve this, bringing together complementary strengths to unlock new opportunities and benefits for our customers. Our collaboration with Emirates Skywards reflects this approach, transforming everyday purchases into rewarding experiences and giving customers more ways to benefit from the services they already use. As customer expectations continue to evolve, we remain focused on building partnerships that go beyond convenience to deliver meaningful, lasting value and make every interaction with ENOC more rewarding." Dr Nejib Ben Khedher, Divisional Senior Vice President Emirates Skywards, said: ‘At Emirates Skywards, we are continuously looking for new ways to make our members' everyday lives more rewarding. Our partnership with ENOC is an exciting addition to our growing lifestyle ecosystem, allowing members to earn Miles on purchases they already make, from filling up their cars to picking up their morning coffee. By bringing Skywards Miles into more moments of daily life, we are making it easier than ever for members to turn everyday spending into extraordinary travel experiences.’ More Miles, every day Through the partnership, Emirates Skywards members can earn: ENOC: 1 Skywards Mile for every AED 10 spent on eligible fuel purchases. ZOOM: 1 Skywards Mile for every AED 5 spent on eligible purchases at participating convenience stores, including locations at Dubai Metro stations. AutoPro: 1 Skywards Mile for every AED 5 spent on eligible automotive services. ProWash: 1 Skywards Mile for every AED 5 spent on eligible car wash services. Turning everyday purchases into extraordinary rewards Whether commuting to work, shopping for essentials or preparing for a weekend road trip, Emirates Skywards members can build their Miles balance through everyday spending and put their rewards towards their next holiday. Skywards Miles can be redeemed for flight rewards with Emirates, flydubai and partner airlines, flight upgrades, hotel stays, retail purchases and exclusive experiences. The ENOC partnership further strengthens Emirates Skywards' growing network of travel and lifestyle partners, reinforcing the programme's commitment to delivering more value, choice and flexibility to members in the UAE and beyond. About Emirates Skywards Skywards Everyday is Emirates Skywards’ lifestyle rewards app, enabling members to earn and spend Miles across hundreds of participating partners in the UAE spanning shopping, dining, groceries, pharmacy, beauty and wellness, leisure, entertainment and services. Members can link up to five eligible Visa or Mastercard credit or debit cards in the app to automatically earn Miles on everyday purchases at participating outlets. Members can also convert Skywards Miles into cashback against eligible purchases and exchange Miles with participating loyalty programmes, providing greater flexibility to earn and enjoy rewards beyond travel. For further information, please visit: https://www.emirates.com/ae/english/skywards/partners/skywards-everyday/ About ENOC Group ENOC Group is a leading integrated global energy player and a wholly owned entity of the Government of Dubai that is integral to the Emirate's success. ENOC owns and operates assets in the fields of exploration & production, supply & operations, terminals, fuel retail, aviation fuel and petroleum products for commercial & industrial use. The Group's general business operations include automotive services, non-fuel F&B retail and fabrication services. Servicing thousands of customers in over 60 markets, the Group employs a multi-national workforce of over 12,500 employees and is deploying its world-class customer service, latest innovations, and technologies as well as best practices to empower the UAE's social and economic development. For further information, please visit: www.enoc.com .

stories.headline: Delta Cargo Transports Drought Relief Supplies to Puerto Rico
stories.lead: Delta Cargo has partnered with New York State and non-profit organizations to deliver nearly 11,000 pounds of drought relief supplies to Puerto Rico.
stories.source_description: Delta Cargo partnered with New York State, the Afya Foundation and SOMOS to deliver nearly 11,000 pounds of drought relief supplies to Puerto Rico, which has experienced widespread drought conditions this year. Delta donated the air freight, joining forces with Governor Kathy Hochul’s office and the Afya Foundation to move the shipment from New York to Puerto Rico. "At Delta Cargo, we’re proud to support efforts that make a meaningful difference in the communities we serve. This shipment reflects the best of Delta Cargo and Delta people, and the power of strong partnerships to help ensure critical supplies reach communities that need them most,” said Peter Penseel, President of Delta Cargo “When our friends and family in Puerto Rico need a helping hand, New York shows up. Grateful to AFYA and Delta for helping make this possible,” Governor Hochul said on social media. Delta Cargo accepted the shipment at its JFK facility on Nov. 3, and the supplies were loaded onto flights to San Juan that week. They were collected and prepared by the Afya Foundation, a Yonkers-based nonprofit that recovers surplus medical supplies from hospitals in the New York City area. Following arrival in Puerto Rico, the supplies were distributed in San Juan through the YMCA of Greater New York and Acción Social, in conjunction with the SOMOS Conference Day of Service. “Thanks to the generosity and collaboration of Delta and our fellow partners, we were able to make a tangible difference in the lives of more than 200 individuals and families throughout Greater San Juan by providing essential food, water and medical supplies. It was a beautiful reminder of what we can accomplish when we come together in service to our communities,” said Sharon Greenberger, President & CEO of the YMCA of Greater New York. A community’s health and success are defined by neighbors coming together to lift one another up in times of need,” said Senator Jamaal T. Bailey. “The impact of this day of service, delivering essential food pantry items to 200 families and providing vital medical equipment like walkers to those who need it most, is a powerful example of what we can achieve through meaningful partnership. I thank Delta, MSG, the YMCA of San Juan, the YMCA of Greater New York, Acción Social, Youth Justice, and SOMOS for their leadership, coordination, and commitment to delivering these resources directly to our family, friends, and neighbors in Puerto Rico.” “On behalf of the Somos Inc Board of Directors we are grateful to Delta for being such a consistent corporate partner in our Annual conference in PR,” said Somos Chairman Francisco Diaz. This is Afya’s second shipment to Puerto Rico in recent months. “Since 2017, Afya has supported communities in Puerto Rico through disasters and everyday medical supply shortages,” said Danielle Butin, Afya’s founder and CEO. “Delta’s generous support is helping us get critical supplies to communities that need them.” Delta has supported Puerto Rico in times of need before, including a relief flight carrying 20,000 pounds of supplies and water after Hurricane Maria in 2017 and cargo support in partnership with New York State after Hurricane Fiona in 2022.

stories.headline: Emirates Introduces Seasonal Thanksgiving Services on US Routes
stories.lead: Emirates is launching festive menus and entertainment across all cabin classes on select US routes and in lounges from 23-30 November.
stories.source_description: Dubai, UAE, November 19, 2026: This year, Emirates celebrates Thanksgiving with festive flavours and entertainment on board, including specially curated menus, holiday shows and NBA games on ice, across all cabin classes on select US routes and in Emirates Lounges in Dubai and the US from 23-30 November. Thanksgiving onboard Emirates In First Class, from flights on US routes to Dubai, Emirates will serve sweet potato soup accompanied by poached lobster and chives, or a generous 19featuring poached prawns, smoked centre-cut salmon, crab cocktail and salmon gravadlax. For the main course, lemon zaatar and buttermilk roasted turkey is paired with celeriac apple purée, maple-roasted caraway pumpkin and beetroot, kale with cranberries, and pecan and cornbread stuffing. Business Class customers will also be able to savour smooth sweet potato soup finished with roasted pumpkin oil and seeds, or the seafood platter, before enjoying lemon zaatar and buttermilk roasted turkey meal. In Premium Economy, a colourful salad starts the meal, followed by tender buttermilk and herb roasted turkey with cranberry jus lié, mashed sweet potatoes, blanched broccolini, paprika potato wedges and honey-glazed pumpkin topped with crushed pecans. In Economy Class, customers start with a Waldorf salad, followed by roasted chicken with chestnut stuffing, served with jus, potato wedges with parsley, glazed carrots, parsnip and Brussels sprouts. The sweet finale includes a selection of autumn-inspired desserts across all cabin classes, including apple crumble tart, spiced pumpkin mousse cake and salted caramel milk cake. On flights from Dubai to the US, customers in First Class can look forward to entrees featuring juniper marinated centre cut salmon or butternut squash soup and dive into the main course of roasted turkey with traditional garnishes. In Business Class, passengers can choose from butternut squash soup or beetroot cured salmon, also available on the Premium Economy menu, before indulging in the main course of roasted turkey with rosemary and garlic. In Economy Class customers can enjoy lentil salad and chicken medallions with mashed parsnip and other trimmings to celebrate. Delectable desserts such as apple crumble tart, spiced pumpkin mousse cake with apple and ginger compote, pumpkin mousse cake with pecan crumble and salted caramel milk cake feature on the menus of First Class, Business Class, Premium Economy and Economy Class. Thanksgiving in Emirates US Lounges Customers visiting Emirates Lounges in New York JFK, Boston, San Francisco and Los Angeles can choose from a warming curried butternut squash bisque with pumpkin seeds and coconut brioche croutons or shaved Brussels sprouts salad with local apples, dried cranberries and maple. Main courses include buttermilk-brined turkey breast with roasted apples and fresh herbs, served with traditional gravy and orange-cranberry compote, or pomegranate molasses-glazed salmon with celery root purée. The Thanksgiving spread is complete with wild mushroom, chestnut and sourdough stuffing, Yukon Gold colcannon mash with savoy cabbage and chives, roasted spaghetti squash with toasted pumpkin seeds and sautéed green beans topped with crispy shallots. Customers with a sweet tooth can round off their meal with Medjool date cake, available in a selection of flavours, or vegan cranberry-orange cookies. A taste of Thanksgiving in Dubai The Thanksgiving table will also be set across Emirates’ Dubai Lounges, where customers can enjoy roasted turkey breast with turkey jus, roasted turkey stuffing, glazed chestnuts and cranberry sauce, alongside roasted new potatoes with paprika and rosemary and roasted root vegetables with Brussels sprouts. For a decadent finish, the dessert selection includes maple walnut cake, pecan brownie, pumpkin cheesecake, white chocolate and cranberry cheesecake, and pumpkin pie tart. Customers can toast the occasion with a pumpkin spiced martini, maple pumpkin sangria or non-alcoholic spiced pear delight. Thanksgiving entertainment on ice Enhancing the Thanksgiving vibes, customers can settle in to watch the NBA games live on Sport24 and Sport24 Extra and see the Milwaukee Bucks, Boston Celtics, Dallas Mavericks, Los Angeles Lakers, Golden State Warriors and more in action, over the Thanksgiving period. Emirates’ inflight entertainment system ice will also feature a wide array of holiday seasonal content, alongside more than 3,000 movies, 600 TV shows and 4,000 hours of music, podcasts and audiobooks, with content available in more than 40 languages . Emirates flights to and from the US Emirates currently offers flights to 12 destinations in the US, including Boston Logan International Airport (BOS), New York’s John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK), Los Angeles International Airport (LAX), Houston’s George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH), Chicago’s O'Hare International Airport (ORD), Washington D.C.’s Dulles International Airport (IAD), Seattle-Tacoma Airport (SEA), Newark Liberty International Airport (EWR), Orlando International Airport (MCO), Dallas Fort Worth Airport (DFW), San Francisco International Airport (SFO) and Miami International Airport (MIA).

stories.headline: Emirates Debuts DXB First Class Lounge as Part of AED 400 Million Transformation
stories.lead: Emirates has opened a new First Class Lounge at Dubai International Airport's Terminal 3, marking the initial phase of a broader AED 400 million lounge overhaul.
stories.source_description: Luxurious new lounge offers an exclusive preview of Emirates’ next-generation airport hospitality experience AED 400 million investment will transform Emirates’ flagship lounges in Dubai, introducing new concepts in dining, wellness, entertainment and personalised service New lounge will welcome First Class customers for approximately one year before becoming an enhanced Business Class Lounge Dubai, UAE, 19 November 2026: Emirates is ushering in a new era of luxury on the ground, revealing an exquisitely finished First Class Lounge at Concourse B, Terminal 3, Dubai International Airport (DXB). Open to customers from 18 November, the new lounge will welcome First Class customers on a temporary basis for one year, before being transformed into a next-generation Business Class Lounge. This reveal offers the first glimpse into Emirates’ AED 400 million transformation of all flagship lounges, each designed with next-generation features and unmistakable Emirates DNA. Sir Tim Clark, President Emirates Airline, said: ‘ Our customers expect the very best from Emirates, whether while flying or spending time with us on the ground. We believe the airport experience should be every bit as exceptional as the journey itself, and that’s why we are transforming our lounges globally. This new First Class Lounge in Dubai is the first taste of what’s to come. And if these are the lengths we will go to for a temporary lounge… just imagine what you can expect from new Emirates Lounges going forward. Over the next two years, we’ll be unveiling a completely different lounge experience, with new concepts in dining, wellness, entertainment and personalised hospitality. We’re going well beyond a traditional refurbishment and creating extraordinary spaces.’ The future of Emirates Lounges Emirates is undertaking an extensive two-year programme to significantly elevate the Emirates lounge experience across Terminal 3, introducing a new generation of premium spaces designed around the evolving needs of today's travellers. As part of the transformation, Emirates is also expanding its lounge footprint at Dubai Airport (DXB) by introducing a brand-new Business Class Lounge, increasing the total number of dedicated Emirates lounges in Terminal 3 from seven to eight. Featuring immersive culinary experiences to dedicated wellness facilities and innovative entertainment concepts, Emirates is redefining what customers can expect from their time at the airport. Building on Emirates’ renowned hospitality, customers can expect distinct spaces for dining, relaxation, work and socialising - complemented by intuitive technology, refined interiors and elevated personal service. Each lounge will bear the hallmarks of the iconic Emirates brand, with the interiors conveying luxury, comfort, exceptional hospitality and global appeal. The investment reinforces Emirates' commitment to delivering an exceptional experience at every stage of the customer journey, both in the air and on the ground. New temporary First Class Lounge – the details The first reveal is a beautifully redesigned First Class Lounge in Concourse B, offering customers an exclusive preview of the design philosophy and elevated hospitality concepts that will shape Emirates' next-generation lounges. Created as a luxurious temporary First Class retreat while the wider refurbishment programme is ongoing, the lounge brings together contemporary elegance, comfort and functionality - in Emirates’ signature tones of gold, bronze, marble with accents of red. Customers can unwind in individual, multipurpose seats with built-in chargers, footrests and tables, or settle into quieter corners designed for relaxation with chaise longue style daybeds, blankets, pillows and individual privacy. For those who wish to work, there is an abundance of tables and dedicated workspaces feature integrated power outlets and wireless charging, allowing guests to stay seamlessly connected. Within the realm of dining, Emirates’ new lounges echo Dubai’s finest and most iconic resorts, with vast options from counter seating with sweeping runway views, to social and interactive dining tables, to vibrant bar areas. A striking new coffee and cocktail bar named Brew Bar offers expertly prepared beverages, while a refreshed culinary experience brings together à la carte dining as well as live cooking, international buffet selections, freshly prepared sushi and Emirates’ remarkably popular First Class sandwich bar. Every detail has been considered to enhance the pre-flight experience, from elegant new furnishings and ambient lighting to beautifully appointed marble and gold shower suites featuring premium VOYA toiletries. Dedicated family facilities, accessible shower suites and inclusive design features ensure a welcoming and comfortable experience for all guests. The new lounge will welcome First Class customers for approximately 12 months before being transformed into an enhanced Business Class facility – to coincide with the opening of Emirates’ new First Class Lounge in Concourse B in 2027. Two new next-generation Lounges for First Class customers in 2027 The opening marks the beginning of a series of major lounge reveals, with Emirates' First Class Lounge in Concourse C scheduled to welcome customers in mid-late 2027, followed by the redesigned First Class Lounge in Concourse B in mid-late 2027. These flagship spaces will introduce an exciting new dimension to premium airport hospitality, with greater opportunities for privacy, personalisation, wellbeing and indulgence. For customers seeking exclusivity, new prestige VIP suites with private ensuite facilities and dedicated dining rooms will offer intimate, sophisticated retreats away from the main lounge. Wellness will become an integral part of the Emirates lounge experience, with dedicated fitness facilities, spa concepts and relaxation spaces, and a new generation of leisure and entertainment areas will further elevate the experience, with concepts including a golf simulator, sports lounge and dedicated family and children's spaces. Dining will also take centre stage and new culinary concepts will include Japanese speciality counters with freshly prepared sushi, artisan bakery and pizza ovens, dessert bars and live cooking experiences. A distinctive 'Made in Dubai' dining concept will celebrate the flavours and culinary heritage of the city, alongside premium international cuisine. Customers will also be able to discover curated fine wines at a Le Clos wine cellar, enjoy expertly crafted cocktails and speciality coffees, or indulge in Emirates’ exclusive to First Class offering - Dom Pérignon Champagne. Two next generation Lounges for Business Class customers over next two years Emirates' Business Class lounges are also undergoing a sweeping transformation, with the refurbishment of Concourse B introducing a series of new experiences across multiple zones, as well as a brand new lounge in Concourse C. In Concourse B, the Lounge will feature a redesigned reception experience, with dedicated Emirates Skywards service counters, accessible biometric entry gates and a reception area specifically for customers with accessible travel requirements. Inside the lounge, contemporary interiors will create a seamless transition between vibrant social areas and peaceful quiet zones. New coffee and beverage bars will provide inviting spaces to gather, while the 'Made in Dubai' culinary concept will introduce a fresh celebration of local flavours. Subsequent phases will unveil an expanded selection of live cooking stations, freshly baked breads and pizzas, sushi bars, pasta counters and speciality desserts. The Emirates Moët & Chandon Lounge will also be redesigned, bringing a refined new setting for customers to discover exclusive champagne and canapé pairings. Further enhancements will continue through 2027 and 2028, introducing new culinary concepts and upgraded dining and hospitality facilities. The new lounge concept will also pay tribute to Dubai, with locally inspired design elements and artwork that celebrate the city’s heritage and cultural identity. A specially commissioned collection by artist Tina Ahmed, entitled The Dubai Heritage Collection, draws inspiration from the city's history before its iconic skyline, when life was shaped by the Creek, the sea and the desert. In Concourse C, a brand new Emirates Business Class Lounge will offer a sophisticated, residential-inspired environment, with elegant reception area and signature design features include Rolex clocks displaying global time zones, a striking Ghaf tree honouring the UAE’s cultural heritage, and a light-filled Botanical Glass Atrium showcasing lush greenery to create a calming sense of tranquillity. The spacious lounge will offer a variety of comfortable leather seating options, including semi-enclosed individual seats, banquettes, two- and four-seater loungers, and communal spaces for working and socialising, with universal charging points and wireless chargers at every seat. Guests can also refresh in luxurious, spa-inspired shower suites and dedicated prayer rooms. A wide range of new culinary attractions for Business Class guests will include freshly prepared international and regional dishes, an authentic Arabic mezze bar, a dedicated Noodle Bar serving made-to-order dishes, a Dim Sum station offering freshly steamed delicacies, and convenient self-service tea and coffee stations. A new Brew Bar will celebrate global coffee culture with specialty coffees, as well as Emirates’ signature selection of champagne, cocktails and beers. Designed for every traveller, at every stage of the journey Across the refurbishment programme, Emirates is placing greater emphasis on accessibility, convenience and individual customer needs. Enhanced facilities will include wheelchair-accessible reception counters and biometric gates, dedicated reception areas, accessible shower suites and washrooms, and inclusive private lounge spaces. For travellers seeking peace and quiet, carefully designed relaxation zones will provide comfortable seating, soft lighting and an atmosphere conducive to rest. Dedicated nursing and mother-and-baby facilities, family areas and children's playrooms will also offer greater comfort and flexibility for customers travelling with young children. The transformation reflects Emirates' focus on creating lounges that adapt to the individual needs of its customers, whether they have just minutes before departure or several hours between flights. Investing in the Emirates experience worldwide The AED 400 million transformation of Emirates' Dubai lounges builds on the airline's wider investment in next-generation airport hospitality across its global network. Emirates currently operates 34 dedicated lounges at international airports, in addition to its flagship facilities in Dubai. Its new signature lounge design has already been introduced in destinations including Munich, Frankfurt and Manchester, bringing the airline's latest premium hospitality concepts to customers around the world. With the addition of the new Concourse C facility, Emirates' dedicated lounge network will expand to 42 lounges worldwide, including eight at Dubai International Airport. Emirates lounges are available to eligible First Class and Business Class customers, as well as Emirates Skywards Platinum and Gold members, with paid access also offered subject to availability.
